terms.definition: The source-attested replacement surface of an explicit allomorph rule; this does not relate semantic concepts.
terms.source_justification: The source C_A rule maps input fbm via fv to output vw under its stated condition.
terms.skos_gap: SKOS semantic relations link concepts; an attested surface replacement is not concept hierarchy or association.
terms.rdf_gap: Generic rdf:value cannot distinguish the input, intermediate and replacement roles on the same rule resource.
